prompt:
We need to add rate-limited webhook delivery to an existing Go monolith that already has a job queue and Postgres. Users register HTTP endpoints; our system must call them reliably, within per-customer rate limits.

Before any implementation: (1) list the clarifying questions you would ask first, ranked by how much the answers would change the design; (2) identify the two or three core design decisions and the trade-offs of each; (3) sketch a brief design (components, data model, failure handling) once you have stated your assumptions. Keep it under ~600 words.
system: You are a pragmatic senior engineer. Surface assumptions and trade-offs explicitly; ask questions before inventing requirements.
